description: Qiskit-backed Trotter-Suzuki evolution using PauliEvolutionGate with LieTrotter or SuzukiTrotter synthesis.
applicable_hamiltonians: Dense matrix Hamiltonian terms convertible to SparsePauliOp
Local or sparse Hamiltonians suitable for circuit synthesis
Hamiltonians intended for Qiskit circuit workflows
limitations: Input terms must be square Hermitian matrices with power-of-two dimension
Large dense matrices can make conversion to Pauli operators expensive
Reported circuit resources use a declared logical basis and omit hardware routing unless the caller performs a separate backend transpilation

order.description: Product formula order. Order 1 uses LieTrotter; higher orders use Qiskit SuzukiTrotter.

execution.returns: EvolutionResult with a dense Qiskit-synthesized unitary or reusable compiled QuantumCircuit, backend version provenance, declared basis, logical wire map, gate counts, and depth; evolve(...) remains compatible.

complexity.gate_count: Formula-level Pauli exponentials and compiled one-/two-qubit gates are reported separately after explicit product-formula synthesis
complexity.circuit_depth: Reported after transpilation to the declared logical basis; hardware routing is not included by default
complexity.error_scaling: Product-formula error depends on order, step count, simulation time, and commutator structure
